models.name: BitNet b1.58 (100B)

engines.quant: 1.58-bit (ternary) b1.58, bitnet.cpp kernels; engine-documented figure for a 100B BitNet b1.58 model (~human reading speed)

models.why: Microsoft's BitNet.cpp 1-bit/1.58-bit inference framework reports a 100B BitNet b1.58 model running on a single CPU at ~5-7 t/s (est, engine-vendor-documented figure quoted in the source X post). CPU t/s figures are sparse on X; this is the framework's own stated capability.
